The '''Club''' is the first one-handed [[Clubs|club]]. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Unlike other one-handed [[clubs]], it has no secondary attack.

* Club can also be upgraded at the [[Forge of Potential]] with a [[Wooden Battle Idol]].

==Notes==
* Not very effective at quality 1, as a [[Flint Axe]] may be preferred. The Club becomes much stronger with upgrades, especially against [[Skeleton]]s, which take 50% more damage from blunt.
